evaluation.heldout: episode final 40%; odd-Qin frame CFO on frames whose even fold passed the frozen support gate
reported_metrics: held-out odd-Qin RMS and median absolute error

sharing_classification.favorable: equal-capture pooled shared/separate heldout RMS ratio < 1, shared/median-individual bootstrap sigma ratio < 1, and no evaluable capture RMS ratio > 1.10

evaluation.train: episode first 60%; supported even-Qin frame CFO only
evaluation.truth_language: rates are estimator measurements and cross-path disagreements, never calibrated satellite-truth errors
evaluation.uncertainty: deterministic 50 ms residual-block bootstrap, 500 replicates, seed 418050

non_evaluable_reasons: insufficient frozen even-selected odd-Qin heldout support

frequency_coordinate.authority: uncalibrated nominal frequency; LNB and sample-clock drift are not measured or removed
frequency_coordinate.nominal_sky_frequency_rule: applied IF center plus nominal LNB LO
frequency_coordinate.normalization_rule: multiply each path-local CFO and CFO residual by 11 GHz / nominal sky frequency before fitting the shared rate

measurement.continuity: one counter-authoritative, gap-free V2 device-time segment required
measurement.frame_epoch_source: exact frozen GLRT64 local epoch propagated on the fixed round(n * sample_rate / 750) lattice
measurement.response_symbols: odd Qin only; never used for membership, fit, alias, thresholds, or model selection

causal_500ms_comparator.fit: per path Huber line on strictly earlier even-Qin measurements
causal_500ms_comparator.name: fixed_500ms_past_only_path_line
causal_500ms_comparator.response: current odd-Qin CFO on the identical even-selected target mask

primary.fit: Huber IRLS, tuning constant 1.345, maximum 50 iterations, relative tolerance 1e-10
primary.name: shared_normalized_rate_free_path_offsets

separate_rate_comparator.fit: same Huber IRLS and identical masks
separate_rate_comparator.name: separate_path_robust_rates

selection.alias_rule: among final-bank automatic_correction_trajectory_ids for the frozen branch, maximize median_block_corrected_margin; then minimize absolute alias index; then minimize alias index
selection.episode_rule: take the centered 1.500000000 s subinterval of the reconstructed full overlap using integer UTC nanoseconds
selection.full_overlap_rule: intersect each selected branch [start, stop] after adding its stream first-sample device-counter UTC estimate
selection.same_emitter_source: exact screen_path_ids and screen_branch_ids from the committed retrospective row
selection.source_epoch_rule: within 75 ms of the episode midpoint in path-local time, maximize committed GLRT64 margin, then exact score, then proximity; require exact dealiased source-observation identity
selection.upstream_conditioning_disclosure: branch, alias, source epoch, and frame lattice come from committed Standard GLRT64 products that used even and odd Qin; only the new local rate fit withholds odd Qin
